title: Peru & South America: The Chilean Fjords
subtitle: Pre-cruise Peru extension + Viking Jupiter, Santiago to Buenos Aires

vessel.name: Viking Jupiter
vessel.design: All-veranda small ship — every stateroom has a private veranda
highlights: Explorers' Dome — a forward-facing planetarium and theater-style venue on Deck 8
The Nordic Spa, infinity pool and heated indoor/outdoor Aquavit Terrace
Multiple dining venues including The Restaurant, World Café, Manfredi's and Chef's Table
No casino or children's facilities — an adults-oriented, destination-focused ship
Docks in smaller, harder-to-reach ports that larger cruise ships cannot access
vessel.sourceNote: Ship facts from viking.com and public Viking Ocean specification sheets, current as of 2026.

legend.scenic: Scenic sailing — no docking, but notable views

days.title: Arrive in Lima
days.summary: Transfer from Lima airport to the hotel. First night of the pre-cruise Best of Peru extension.
days.lodging: Wyndham Grand Costa del Sol, Lima Airport

days.title: Sacred Valley
days.summary: Transfer from Lima to the Sacred Valley of the Incas. Two nights based in Urubamba to explore the valley ahead of Cusco.

days.title: Cusco
days.summary: Transfer from the Sacred Valley to Cusco, the historic Inca capital, for two nights before joining the ship.

days.title: Transfer to the ship & embark
days.summary: Transfer from Cusco to Santiago (Valparaíso) and embark Viking Jupiter. Embarkation at 13:00. Stateroom: Penthouse Veranda.

days.title: Valparaíso, Chile
days.summary: First full day, docked in Valparaíso — the colorful port city on Chile's central coast.

activities.title: Valparaíso & Museums
activities.description: Discover the city of two halves, Valparaíso, and enjoy a short sojourn in Viña del Mar to visit the Fonck Museum. Valparaíso's upper area, Los Cerros, is a maze of residences nestled among 42 hills. Marvel at the views from the top, then visit the Baburizza Palace, admiring its collection of artworks by European and Chilean artists. Descend to the foot of the hill for a stroll around Plaza Sotomayor and view the naval headquarters building and the Monument to the Heroes of Iquique. Continue by motor coach to Viña del Mar and visit the Fonck Museum, featuring archaeological artifacts and historic items from the Chilean mainland and Rapa Nui (Easter Island).

days.title: Sail the Pacific Ocean
days.summary: A day at sea, sailing south along the Chilean coast toward Puerto Montt.

days.title: Puerto Montt, Chile
days.summary: Gateway to Chile's Lake District, with views of the Osorno volcano and German colonial heritage in nearby Puerto Varas and Frutillar.

activities.title: Puerto Varas & Lake District Drive
activities.description: Immerse yourself in pristine nature during a panoramic drive along the western shores of Llanquihue Lake. Chile's second-largest lake features a majestic backdrop of the snowcapped Osorno and Calbuco volcanoes, often reflected in its crystal-clear waters. Continue to Puerto Varas, known as the “City of Roses,” for free time to soak up the views or browse the local shops.

days.title: Scenic Sailing: Chilean Fjords
days.summary: A full day of scenic sailing through the narrow channels and fjords of Chilean Patagonia — no port stop.

days.title: Scenic Sailing: Amalia Glacier
days.summary: Sailing past the Amalia (Skua) Glacier, one of the most spectacular tidewater glaciers in the Chilean fjords.

days.title: Punta Arenas, Chile
days.summary: Chile's southernmost major city on the Strait of Magellan, gateway to Chilean Patagonia.

activities.title: Panoramic Punta Arenas
activities.description: Discover the charm of Chile's most southerly city, situated by the Strait of Magellan. Starting at Cerro de la Cruz, marvel at views of the city, the Strait and Tierra del Fuego Island. Take a scenic drive past the Monumento al Ovejero (Sheepdog Monument), then have time to browse the handicraft market in Plaza de Armas before returning to the ship.

days.title: Ushuaia, Argentina
days.summary: The “City at the End of the World” and gateway to Tierra del Fuego National Park.

activities.title: Tierra del Fuego National Park
activities.description: Argentina's first shoreline national park stretches north from the Beagle Channel along the Chilean border. Its diverse landscape encompasses lush forests, wildflower-filled meadows and snowcapped mountain peaks, with pale-gray trunks from trees damaged by beavers standing out against the green landscape. Stops at Panoramic Point, Acigami Lake and Lapataia Bay offer photo opportunities of rugged mountains mirrored in silver lakes.

activities.title: Snapshots of Ushuaia
activities.description: Discover the intriguing history and scenic views of Ushuaia, the “City at the End of the World.” Set out by motor coach, passing landmarks including the Government House and the End of the World Museum, the Plaza Islas Malvinas memorial and the Old Prison of Ushuaia, which occupies remnants of the old presidio. Enjoy a guided tour of the museum before returning to the ship.

days.title: Scenic Sailing: Cape Horn
days.summary: Rounding Cape Horn, the southernmost headland of the Tierra del Fuego archipelago, where the Pacific and Atlantic meet.

days.title: Sail the Atlantic Ocean
days.summary: A day at sea, heading north-east across the South Atlantic toward the Falkland Islands.

days.title: Port Stanley, Falkland Islands
days.summary: The Falklands' compact capital, known for its wildlife-rich coastline and colonial-era architecture.

activities.title: Scenic Gypsy Cove
activities.description: Explore the rugged natural beauty and local wildlife of the Falklands during a visit to Gypsy Cove: a walking trail overlooking a wind-sheltered stretch of white-sand beach and Port Stanley's most accessible National Nature Reserve. Keep watch for Magellanic penguins and other species of birds such as upland geese and rock cormorants, with viewing platforms along the way.

days.title: Sail the Atlantic Ocean
days.summary: A day at sea, continuing north along the Argentine coast toward Puerto Madryn.

days.title: Puerto Madryn, Argentina
days.summary: Gateway to Peninsula Valdés, a UNESCO World Heritage wildlife sanctuary, and a city with strong Welsh settler heritage.

activities.title: Punta Loma Sea Lions & Puerto Madryn's Heritage
activities.description: Learn about Puerto Madryn's Welsh origins and view the sea lion colony at Punta Loma Natural Reserve, Argentina's oldest marine reserve and home to a permanent sea lion colony. Continue to Punta Cuevas to see the El Indio monument, then visit the Museo del Desembarco Punta Cuevas to learn about the founding of Puerto Madryn and its Welsh heritage.

days.title: Sail the Atlantic Ocean
days.summary: A day at sea, en route toward Montevideo.

days.title: Sail the Atlantic Ocean
days.summary: A second day at sea, approaching the Río de la Plata estuary.

days.title: Montevideo, Uruguay
days.summary: Uruguay's compact, walkable capital on the Río de la Plata.

activities.title: The Art of Uruguay
activities.description: Explore the artistic heritage of Uruguay during an excursion to two museums exhibiting national artists. Start with a tour of the historic Old Town at the former city gate, then pass the well-preserved colonial-era buildings surrounding Constitution Square. Visit the Joaquín Torres García Museum, home to the works of Uruguay's most influential artist, then see the Blanes Museum and the Visual Arts Museum.

activities.title: Discover Montevideo & Carnival Museum
activities.description: Admire Montevideo's landmarks, parks and gardens, then visit the Carnival Museum. See the monument to national hero José Gervasio Artigas, the Government House and the Solís Theater, before continuing to the Legislative Palace. Return to the Ciudad Vieja for a visit to the Carnival Museum, showcasing the traditions of this beloved festival, with a murga performance.

days.title: Buenos Aires, Argentina
days.summary: Arrival in Buenos Aires, the final port — the ship remains docked overnight ahead of disembarkation.

activities.title: Highlights of Buenos Aires
activities.description: Experience the diverse communities of Buenos Aires during a scenic tour. Around the Plaza de Mayo, see the city's major public buildings such as the Cabildo, Buenos Aires Metropolitan Cathedral and the rose-colored presidential palace (Casa Rosada). Visit the Zanjón de Granados, a museum housed above a set of tunnels dating back to Buenos Aires' early settlements. Cap the tour with a stop in La Boca, the city's most colorful neighborhood.

activities.title: Milonga Night
activities.description: Enjoy a night to remember as you mingle with locals and enjoy an evening of dance. The tango is synonymous with Buenos Aires; the dance was added to the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage Lists in 2009. Meet your guide and head to a local club, where the porteños gather together to dance the night away. Take to the floor with a partner, who will show you the steps while a live tango orchestra provides the music.

days.title: Disembark in Buenos Aires
days.summary: Disembark Viking Jupiter in Buenos Aires — end of the cruise.
